response.overview: Life is a constant cycle of “action and reaction”—a struggle between various forces or variables. We all respond to stimuli and situations, with our behavior and personal experience serving as the outcome. Given the lives we have lived—shaped by both circumstance and choice—we know that some moments are difficult to share. In *Reactions*, the characters undergo a kind of internal catharsis, acknowledging and revealing their own variables: memories, longings, fleeting moments, feelings, emotions… experiences. These are scattered confessions and subtle actions—things with which you might just find yourself identifying.
response.title: Reacciones
